id: AT-GR-03 gsd path guard, non-ASCII checkout, pure-Perl Cwd
note: RF-1, the GSD path guard of measure <handoff> (R3): with Cwd::abs_path and Cwd::realpath bound to the pure-Perl fast_abs_path, as Perl under MSYS and Cygwin (Git Bash) binds them (a perl stub first on PATH loads FastCwd.pm, which aliases them), the frontmatter gsd path (a character string) given to Cwd::realpath came back encoded twice, `-e "$d/.git"` missed the nested checkout's .git and a foreign handoff's STATE.md in another checkout was read. The guard now resolves through skills::util::abs_path, which hands Cwd bytes. A STATE.md of this checkout is still read.
